story: The steel ball is released and rolls down the steep plank.
It runs along the level shelf and hits the first domino.
The dominoes topple one after another along the shelf.
The last domino pushes the golf ball off the end of the shelf.
The golf ball drops onto the glass ramp and rolls down it.
It leaves the ramp's low end and drops into the cup.
